items.name: Sagging sofa
items.description: Sags in the middle, which is exactly where the cat sleeps.

items.name: Armchair
items.description: Your chair, in theory.

items.name: Wool rug
items.description: Thick wool. The cat regards it as a mattress with ambitions.

items.name: Floor lamp
items.description: A tall lamp that makes the whole room look kinder.

items.name: Bookshelf
items.description: Holds books until the cat decides otherwise.

items.name: Coffee table
items.description: Low table for mugs, magazines and a cat lying across both.

items.name: Cardboard box
items.description: The most popular piece of furniture in the house. It is a box.

items.name: Scratching post
items.description: Sisal-wrapped and sacrificial. The sofa is grateful.

items.name: Window-seat cushion
items.description: A long mustard cushion by the glass, for watching the street.

items.name: Radiator seat
items.description: Old cast iron, painted cream, permanently occupied.

items.name: Record player
items.description: Turns at a steady pace. The cat watches every rotation.

items.name: Houseplant
items.description: A large leafy plant with one leaf already missing.

items.name: Fireplace
items.description: A small tiled hearth. Whatever sits in front of it becomes a bed.

items.name: Cat tree
items.description: Carpeted platforms at several heights, for looking down on you.

items.name: Wall clock
items.description: Tells the time. The cat prefers to tell you itself.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: A framed print. The cat has no opinion. Yet.

items.name: Double bed
items.description: A double bed. You are allotted a third of it.

items.name: Bedside table
items.description: Holds a lamp, a glass of water and, briefly, a cat.

items.name: Wardrobe
items.description: Two doors, one always slightly open. You know why.

items.name: Laundry basket
items.description: A wicker basket of clean washing. Was clean.

items.name: Reading lamp
items.description: Brass and green glass. Good light to read by, or nap under.

items.name: Curtains
items.description: Long sage curtains on a brass pole. Climbable, in theory.

items.name: Chest of drawers
items.description: Three drawers of jumpers and a top made for sitting on.

items.name: Cat bed
items.description: A round plush bed made for the cat, who prefers yours.

items.name: Slippers
items.description: Fluffy pink slippers. One of them will go missing.

items.name: Oval mirror
items.description: A tall oval mirror. The cat finds the other cat suspicious.

items.name: Dressing-gown hook
items.description: A dressing gown on a brass hook. Smells reassuringly of you.

items.name: Cat hammock
items.description: A teal canvas sling for a cat who likes to be held up.

items.name: Alarm clock
items.description: Twin bells and a loud tick. Due to be knocked off something.

items.name: Bedroom rug
items.description: A soft sage rug by the bed. The cat lands on it by gravity.

items.name: Food bowl
items.description: The cat's bowl. The most important object in the house.

items.name: Water fountain
items.description: A trickling fountain, because still water is beneath them.

items.name: Kitchen table
items.description: A square pine table. Strictly off limits, according to you.

items.name: Kitchen chair
items.description: Spindle-backed pine. Warm if you've just got up.

items.name: Fridge
items.description: Rounded, cream and full of things the cat has opinions about.

items.name: Kettle
items.description: A mint stove-top kettle. Whistles, steams, gets stared at.

items.name: Herb shelf
items.description: Three pots of herbs on a little shelf. One has been nibbled.

items.name: Bread bin
items.description: Cream enamel with a wooden lid. Fits a loaf. Fits a cat.

items.name: Fruit bowl
items.description: Lemons and oranges, ideal for rolling off things.

items.name: Cooker
items.description: Four rings and a chrome rail. Off limits, always.

items.name: Cat flap
items.description: A door within a door. Used entirely at the cat's discretion.

items.name: Radio
items.description: A little cream and mint radio. Plays music, scatters notes.

items.name: Door mat
items.description: Coir, scratchy and inexplicably popular for naps.

items.name: Sink
items.description: A white sink in a pine unit. Apparently also a bed.

items.name: Garden bench
items.description: Weathered oak with room for two. Mostly used by one.

items.name: Sunbeam spot
items.description: A warm patch of sunlight. Turns up only when the sun does.

items.name: Bird feeder
items.description: Seed on a tall post. Popular with birds and their audience.

items.name: Flower pots
items.description: Three terracotta pots of geraniums, nodding along.

items.name: Watering can
items.description: A green metal watering can. Mostly decorative.

items.name: Deck chair
items.description: Striped canvas in teal and cream. You'll be lucky to get it.

items.name: Garden shed
items.description: A little sage-green shed with a window and many hiding places.

items.name: Picket fence
items.description: A run of white pickets, for walking along smugly.

items.name: Pond
items.description: Two water lilies and a great many things worth staring at.

items.name: Festoon lights
items.description: Round warm bulbs strung in a lazy curve along the wall.

items.name: Rope hammock
items.description: Strung between two posts. Sways gently under a sleeping cat.

items.name: Washing line
items.description: Clothes pegged out to dry. One sock is at risk.

items.name: Writing desk
items.description: Pale oak with one drawer. The cat sits wherever you type.

items.name: Office chair
items.description: A mustard swivel chair. Turns when nobody is looking.

items.name: Laptop
items.description: Warm, glowing and the ideal place for a cat to help.

items.name: Tall bookshelf
items.description: Floor-to-ceiling walnut with a small globe on top.

items.name: Paper tray
items.description: An in-tray, mostly full of cat.

items.name: Desk lamp
items.description: Green glass and brass. A soft glow over the paperwork.

items.name: Globe
items.description: A vintage globe on a brass stand. Turns with one nudge.

items.name: Filing cabinet
items.description: Two drawers of paperwork and one very good hiding place.

items.name: Printer
items.description: Prints occasionally, warm always. The cat approves of warm.

items.name: Noticeboard
items.description: Cork, pinned with notes and a postcard. Pins are not toys.

items.name: Mug of tea
items.description: A large mug of tea, left far too close to the edge.

items.name: Roller blind
items.description: A cream roller blind, half drawn and gently swinging.

items.name: Old trunk
items.description: Leather, brass corners, faded stickers, lid ajar.

items.name: Dusty armchair
items.description: Faded rose velvet under a half-pulled dust sheet.

items.name: Skylight beam
items.description: A square of sunlight under the skylight. Sunny days only.

items.name: Stacked boxes
items.description: Three old boxes, the top one open. A lookout and a den.

items.name: Rocking horse
items.description: A painted wooden horse that rocks when brushed against.

items.name: Dressmaker's dummy
items.description: A dressmaker's dummy. The cat has never trusted it.

items.name: Telescope
items.description: Brass, on a wooden tripod. Excellent for watching birds.

items.name: Rolled rug
items.description: Rolled up and tied with string. Better than unrolled.

items.name: Oil lamp
items.description: An antique oil lamp, lit, on a little round table.

items.name: Cobweb corner
items.description: A silvery cobweb high in the corner. Someone's favourite.

items.name: Suitcase
items.description: An old leather suitcase. Open it and the cat moves in.

items.name: Old wireless
items.description: A big wooden wireless that hums as it warms up.

items.name: Moving boxes
items.description: Two sealed moving boxes. Not sealed for long.

items.name: Tea chest
items.description: A wooden tea chest with stencilled letters. Smells faintly of tea.

items.name: Paint tins
items.description: Sage, mustard and cream. One lid is off. Paws clear, please.

items.name: Step ladder
items.description: A wooden step ladder, for pictures, shelves and surveillance.

items.name: Fairy lights
items.description: Tiny warm lights draped in two swags along the wall.

items.name: Picnic blanket
items.description: A checked blanket on the floor of a house with no table yet.

items.name: Takeaway bag
items.description: First-night takeaway. The paper bag is the real prize.

items.name: Scented candle
items.description: A scented candle in amber glass. Smells like a new home.

items.name: Knitted blanket
items.description: A chunky cream knit, folded once. It won't stay folded.

items.name: Log basket
items.description: A wicker basket of split logs, ready for the fire.

items.name: Wreath
items.description: Fir, berries and a tartan bow, hung at a batting height.

items.name: Snow globe
items.description: A tiny cottage under glass. Shake it and it snows indoors.

items.name: Fir tree
items.description: A small potted fir with warm lights and very tempting baubles.

items.name: Sledge
items.description: A wooden sledge leaning on the wall, waiting for its moment.

items.name: Hot-water bottle
items.description: In a knitted cover. The cat will claim it before you do.

items.name: Seed trays
items.description: Seedlings in little pots. Not, despite appearances, a litter tray.

items.name: Bird box
items.description: A small wooden bird box. The cat has applied to be a tenant.

items.name: Tulip pot
items.description: Red and yellow tulips in terracotta. For looking at, not nibbling.

items.name: Peg bag
items.description: A floral peg bag on a hook, full of pegs worth batting about.

items.name: Picnic hamper
items.description: A wicker hamper, lid open, contents under review.

items.name: Butterfly jar
items.description: A glass jar with a blue butterfly resting on the rim.

items.name: Wellies
items.description: Yellow wellington boots. One of them has a cat in it.

items.name: Daffodil jug
items.description: A blue enamel jug of daffodils. Cheerful, and best admired.

items.name: Grand fireplace
items.description: Marble, a mantel clock and a proper fire. The grandest bed going.

items.name: Hi-fi console
items.description: Walnut, with a turntable and two speakers. Warm on top.

items.name: String of bulbs
items.description: Big round warm bulbs strung along the wall.

items.name: Welcome mat
items.description: Coir, and it says WELCOME. The cat agrees, selectively.

items.name: House portrait
items.description: A little terraced house in a gilt frame. Home, framed.

items.name: Founders' plaque, brass
items.description: Polished brass with a cat silhouette and your founder's number.

items.name: Founders' plaque, slate
items.description: Blue-grey slate, brass screws, and your founder's number.

items.name: Founders' plaque, oak
items.description: Carved honey oak with a cat silhouette and your founder's number.

excluded.reason: Shows alcohol (mulled wine); removed for the 4+ rating.
Shows alcohol (a champagne bottle); removed for the 4+ rating.
